I5.location: main, p. 1666 (PDF p. 2), first sentence of the body text

notes: Two-page microscopy extended abstract (Microsc. Microanal. 16 Suppl 2, 2010). Content is aberration-corrected HRTEM, electron tomography and STEM-EDX of activated carbon fibre supports and Ni/Al composites (Ni particles ~3.7 +/- 1.1 nm, pore diameter ~2 nm). The only mention of BET is "in agreement with the models assumed for BET analysis", with no value reported. No H2 uptake is measured, so I1 fails and the code is no_conditions_stated (not theoretical_only, since the work is experimental; not electrochemical). not_primary was considered and not applied: the document is a short abstract but it reports original microscopy data (micrographs, particle-size statistics), so it is not an abstract without data. If the author reads not_primary as covering any abstract-length item with no H2 uptake data, the code would change to not_primary. record.json is_retracted is false and the PDF does not state retraction. duplicate_data does not apply: no H2 uptake value is reported.
